title: Global Cultural Diversity
description: Directed at non-majors, this course introduces students to the diversity of cultural experience in today’s world. Goals of the course include gaining an appreciation of the equality of everyone’s shared humanity and unique identities both locally and globally; to understand global experiences of cultural diversity through forced or chosen migration; to understand how categories of identity, including racialized, gendered, ethnic, religious, age, class and national identities – shaped by power – are social and cultural, and not biological.
attributes: Distance Learning Approved Meets UK Core Global Dynamics
